_about: Manifest for scripts/css-layers-check.py. Rules: docs/css-layers.md. Entries marked 'unlayered: migrating in batch N' are the W3CSS layers build in progress (planning: themes-layers-plan-w3css-2026-11-10.md); each batch replaces its entries with the layers its files use.

important_allow.div.w3css-animate-border: Only the box-shadow transition of the region boxes. Reveal on scroll (w3css-fade.js) fades the same boxes with its own opacity transition, and the scheme keyframes set a transition on every box; the transition list here must win over both. The reduced-motion block turns it off.

files.css/w3-css/w3.css: ignored: frozen upstream W3.CSS 4.15 reference, not loaded by any library
files.css/base/w3css-host-overrides.css: unlayered: declarations that beat unlayered core, contrib, PB or VVJ CSS before layering; a layer would lose them (head comment lists the rival groups)

css/layout/w3css-node-edit-form.css.colors_note: hex and rgb() literals (borders, backgrounds, shadow, icon fill); to tokens in a later batch

files.fonts/w3css-font-awesome-7.css: ignored: vendored Font Awesome, loaded unlayered on purpose

fonts/*.css.unlayered_tail: headings and classes that beat unlayered core, contrib or Paragraphs Bundles CSS (the PB w3-modern.css heading font) cannot sit in a layer; each starts from the page-wrapper :where() root
